plugins.name: pmcro-trail
plugins.description: Trail-as-Product: durable, schema-conformant PMCR-O trail evidence. Owns New-Trail (Class B guid-folder materialization) and the frame contract every plan/make/check/reflect.jsonl line must satisfy.

plugins.name: pmcro-orchestrator
plugins.description: Sole dispatch authority. orchestrate run claims/opens a cycle, mints-or-links a trail via pmcro-trail, then hands off to Planner. Never does domain work itself.

plugins.name: pmcro-planner
plugins.description: Turns an opened cycle's task into a PlanFrame — goal, ordered steps naming their subject_agent, success_criteria, out_of_scope. Appends to plan.jsonl only; never executes a step itself.

plugins.name: pmcro-maker
plugins.description: Executes one PlanFrame step at a time and logs exactly what happened as a MakeStep. Never decides the plan, never judges success, never closes the cycle.

plugins.name: pmcro-checker
plugins.description: Evaluates a cycle's MakeStep results against the PlanFrame's success_criteria and appends one CheckFrame with a verdict. Never fixes what it finds — that's a new step, in a new or continued Make phase.

plugins.name: pmcro-reflector
plugins.description: Closes a cycle: reads the CheckFrame verdict, records a Reflection with a disposition, optionally proposes and enqueues a next seed, then seals the trail. Sole role permitted to seal.

plugins.name: pmcro-aspire
plugins.description: Wraps the .NET Aspire CLI's local backchannel as a live evidence source: Maker and Checker query real resource state, console/structured logs, and traces via 'aspire describe'/'aspire logs'/'aspire otel' instead of relying on self-reported status.

plugins.name: pmcro-chief-technology-officer
plugins.description: Chief Technology Officer persona: macro-level intent governance for platform and host-capability decisions. Domain execution still runs through the existing five-role cycle. Also ships host-bridge-evidence, a narrowly-scoped skill for querying a linked local machine's real device state and files as Make/Check evidence.

plugins.name: pmcro-chief-executive-officer
plugins.description: Chief Executive Officer persona: macro-level intent governance for company-wide direction and cross-Chief prioritization -- the root persona any AI Agent Company instance starts from. Domain execution still runs through the existing five-role cycle. Also ships queue-intake, a narrowly-scoped skill for checking the real .pmcro/queue/ for items already proposed for a Chief before claiming a brand-new ad hoc seed.
